outcome: Provider-marked final answers stream while tools are offered. Commentary and tool arguments stay hidden; final text excludes commentary. The existing adapter, SDK, text sink and durable execution path remain the only route.

verification.baseline: Initial seven new tests against old product source: six failed, one passed. Both answer cases repeated twice produced zero deltas. Commentary-only output was incorrectly accepted as final.
verification.after: Both answer cases repeated twice emit two exact chunks before response.completed. Wire tests use the installed SDK/Pydantic parser and httpx2 MockTransport, not a real remote provider.
negativeControls: Unmarked text with tools stays non-streaming; marker-looking content grants no permission.
Commentary-only output fails; commentary before/after final text is absent from preview and final answer.
Hosted tool discovery and external tool choice return one deferred action with no visible commentary.
Mixed final answer/external tool fails in either order before returning an executable action.
A failure after visible output makes one request, never a retry.
Changed phase on the same wire message fails without retry.
Replacement PartStartEvents fail without duplicate text; these are framework-event tests, not claims that OpenAI emitted those frames.
earlierAttempts: Tool fixture initially omitted available_actions, then hosted discovery. Both versions failed; the fixture was corrected to represent the real provider protocol. No production retry or admission gate was weakened.
Independent first review requested part replacement/metadata-change coverage; extra guards and four tests added before final review.

realProviderPair.method: Two separate public-adapter calls with the same short synthetic prompt, identity, empty memory and offered synthetic tool, using the existing private subscription lease. Baseline loaded from git 94f3f123; candidate from working source in a separate host process. No application, worker or database was started.
realProviderPair.sourceLimit: The remote pair preceded the additional replacement/phase-change rejection guards. Final reviewed source hash is separately recorded above; its 168-test result includes those guards. Do not relabel this pair as a call on the final commit.
realProviderPair.limits: One pair proves observed streaming compatibility, not general latency, human preference or competitor superiority. Hindsight and subagents were not invoked. This is not Telegram delivery.

Hermes.decision: Adapt separation of commentary/tool/final events, no additional gateway.

OpenClaw.decision: Distinguish progress from answer text; reject a parallel provider-specific formatting route.

AgentZero.decision: Adapt explicit user-answer selection; do not copy JSON parsing or add a response tool.
